parsed.explanation: Visitor risk is High. Parent framework creates traveler-facing border/document exposure: X-marker elimination, visa screening may refuse and pursue permanent fraud bars, and passports have been blocked. National government-funded facility exclusion plus state bans and criminal trespass (with an arrest and birth-sex detention) are universal-exposure measures, not offset by contested laws or domestic protections. The division adds a governor EO defining sex and backing single-sex spaces, plus state custody birth-sex placement with documented sexual assault and a dismissed failure-to-protect suit. Immigration custody abuse and counterterrorism rhetoric increase severity. Because there is no capital/presentation offence and courts sometimes provide partial recourse, it remains above severe anchors; but tier-1 state exposures with weak remedy place it around 0.25.
